title: Co-Work cleanup, Claude replies and Studio startup
summary: Private test build for sent follow-up cards, completed Claude responses and native Studio auto-connect.
improved: Discover the running Windows Studio MCP helper or a complete installed version when the batch launcher is missing.
Attempt Studio connection at app launch and retry when Studio opens later, even when process-name scans miss it.
fixed: Confirmed Co-Work follow-ups disappear immediately; queued and unconfirmed requests remain visible.
Read one owning Claude assistant turn and all non-thinking answer blocks so nested empty nodes do not hide a completed reply.
notes: Private test build. Await user testing and explicit approval before public publication.
Local regression fixtures do not establish live Edge/Claude or real Windows Studio behavior. Platform CI must pass before complete native test packages are considered validated.

github.summary: Private test build; no public release authorized.

sections.title: 🛠️ Fixes
items: Completed Claude replies stay readable across nested response nodes.
More robust Studio MCP discovery and startup retry.

sections.title: 🧪 Testing
items: Automated fixtures cover the reported failure patterns; live user testing remains required.
